description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EmailsViewDeleteDraftEmail' which handles AJAX requests for deleting draft emails in the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic to respond with appropriate messages based on the email's status (draft, save_error, or others). The class extends 'ViewAjax' and manages email-related operations within the email module.
